F2: We talk through approval queues with a lot of controllers at manufacturers in the 200 to 500 person range, and the conversation keeps coming to the same fork.

The patterns we see most are a maintenance manager who owns the maintenance cost centers for every line, a shared "Plant Overhead" or "Facilities" cost center with one owner approving everything, and cost centers whose owner left and which quietly fell back to the CFO as the default approver.
